name: agent-recipes
description: Specialist agents plus multi-step TDD/review/perf workflows for Claude Code, with a safety guard, Signal notifications and cross-device state sync.

guard_mode.title: Safety guard mode
guard_mode.description: auto = block when the session runs commands without asking (acceptEdits, auto, dontAsk, bypassPermissions) and ask you in sessions that prompt; always = block in every session; off = never check.

notify_enabled.title: Signal notifications
notify_enabled.description: Send a Signal message when Claude is waiting on you or finishes a long turn. Needs a local signal-cli daemon.

notify_recipient.title: Notify this Signal number
notify_recipient.description: Number or username to notify, usually your own (e.g. +15551234567). Empty = Note to Self, which does not buzz your phone.

notify_signal_account.title: Signal account of the daemon
notify_signal_account.description: Only needed when the signal-cli daemon serves more than one account.

notify_signal_rpc_url.title: signal-cli JSON-RPC URL
notify_signal_rpc_url.description: HTTP endpoint of the signal-cli daemon.

notify_min_seconds.title: Minimum turn length (seconds)
notify_min_seconds.description: Only send a 'finished' message for turns at least this long.

notify_include_summary.title: Include a summary
notify_include_summary.description: Append the first 200 characters of Claude's last message. Off by default because it may contain sensitive text.

notify_allow_remote.title: Allow a non-local daemon
notify_allow_remote.description: Permit an RPC URL that is not on this machine, such as a daemon on another device over a private network.
